title: Curve quantities: what a curve measures, each with its OSDU LogCurveFamily name

range.source: Kansas Geological Survey, Geological Log Analysis, The Gamma Ray Log: API units are counted against the University of Houston pit of 200 API units, and about 3700 API units is the most expected for the most uranium-rich black shale; rounded up to 4000 (E144 gr-range/1).

family_from.source: Ophiolite's rule over PWLS-3 and the PWLS property tree, not an assignment OSDU publishes: OSDU data-definitions at the osdu block's commit, LogCurveType.1.json (every company's row of a mnemonic), PropertyType.1.json and LogCurveFamily.1.json. A mnemonic names this family when the property types of all its rows lie on one line of the property tree and the nearest one at or above the deepest that carries a family of its own name carries this one. The units are the Energistics symbols (units.json) of the family's unit quantity, or E52's suggesting units where the row has them, less a symbol LAS files write for another unit (MV, a millivolt in LAS, is a megavolt in units.json).
